            <title><![CDATA[News Wrap: Democrats block crypto bill, demand limits on Trump's investments]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/news-wrap-democrats-block-crypto-bill-demand-limits-on-trumps-investments</link>
            <description><![CDATA[In our news wrap Tuesday, Senate Democrats blocked a bill that would have introduced sweeping regulations for cryptocurrencies saying it needs stronger safeguards to prevent the president and other officials from profiting while in office, Kash Patel defended his handling of the FBI during a nearly five-hour Senate hearing and the U.S. military has confirmed it has weapons in space.]]></description>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/sen-mark-warner-says-u-s-can-strengthen-ai-safety-without-losing-race-to-china</link>
            <description><![CDATA[The warnings about artificial intelligence are growing more urgent, and increasingly, they're coming from inside the industry. AI researchers have resigned over safety concerns, while some of the field's prominent leaders are calling for stronger government oversight. But Congress has yet to agree on meaningful safeguards. Geoff Bennett discussed more with Democratic Sen. Mark Warner of Virginia.]]></description>

            <title><![CDATA[NATO jets shoot down drone in Lithuania as Russia continues to provoke Europe]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/nato-jets-shoot-down-drone-in-lithuania-as-russia-continues-to-provoke-europe</link>
            <description><![CDATA[A drone was shot down in Lithuania by a NATO jet. It is unknown from where the drone was launched, but it's the latest in a series of incursions and sabotage attacks across Europe. As Russia presses its war in Ukraine, it is also now confronting NATO. Stephanie Sy discussed more with Doug Lute, a retired Army lieutenant general who was U.S. ambassador to NATO during the Obama administration.]]></description>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/kennedy-center-board-votes-to-close-after-judge-blocks-trumps-name-from-building</link>
            <description><![CDATA[The board of the Kennedy Center in Washington voted to temporarily close the iconic performing arts center, citing financial issues and a need for structural repairs.
